mapper.sql: select id, plan_month, is_complete, file_name, file_path, remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from T_CONSTRUCTION_CHECK
mapper.insert:
SELECT seq_t_construction_check.NEXTVAL as id FROM DUAL
insert into T_CONSTRUCTION_CHECK
id, plan_month, is_complete, file_name, file_path, remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time,
#{id}, #{planMonth}, #{isComplete}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{remark}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime},
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT C.ID, C.SAP_CODE, P.EMBRYO_CODE, P.BOM_DATA_VERSION EMBRYO_VERSION, C.SPEC_DESC, C.NOSE_WIDTH, C.FLIP_DISC_DIAMETER, C.TREAD_CODE, C.TREAD_SAP, C.TREAD_VERSION, C.TREAD_RUBBER_CATEGORY, C.TREAD_MOUTH_PLATE, C.TREAD_SHOULDER_LENGTH, C.SIDEWALL_CODE, C.SIDEWALL_SAP, C.SIDEWALL_VERSION, C.SIDEWALL_RUBBER, C.SIDEWALL_MOUTH_PLATE, C.SIDEWALL_LENGTH, C.INSIDE_CODE, C.INSIDE_SAP, C.INSIDE_VERSION, C.INSIDE_RUBBER, C.TIRE_RING_CODE, C.TIRE_RING_SAP, C.TIRE_RING_VERSION, C.APEX_CODE, C.HEXAGON_RUBBER_CODE, C.HEXAGON_MOUTH_PLATE, C.BEAD_CODE, C.BEAD_SAP, C.BEAD_VERSION, C.BEAD_TYPE, C.BEAD_ARRANGE, C.FIT_DRUM_PERIMETER, C.BELT_CUTTING_ANGLE, C.BELT_CODE1, C.BELT_SAP1, C.BELT1_VERSION, C.BELT_CRAFT1, C.BELT_CODE2, C.BELT_SAP2, C.BELT2_VERSION, C.BELT_CRAFT2, C.ARTICLE_CROWN_SPEC, C.ARTICLE_CROWN_SAP, C.ARTICLE_CROWN_VERSION, C.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE1, C.TIRE_FABRIC_SAP1, C.TIRE_FABRIC1_VERSION, C.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT1, C.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE2, C.TIRE_FABRIC_SAP2, C.TIRE_FABRIC2_VERSION, C.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT2, C.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE3, C.TIRE_FABRIC_SAP3, C.TIRE_FABRIC3_VERSION, C.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT3, C.CORD_SPEC, C.CORD_SAP, C.CORD_VERSION, C.ORIGINAL_LINE_CODE, C.DEL_FLAG, C.DIMENSION, C.SECTION_WIDTH, C.HEXAGON_RUBBER_DIMENSION, C.PRODUCTION_STAGE, C.REINFORCE_SEAL_GLUE FROM T_MDM_MONTH_PLAN_MAIN M INNER JOIN T_MDM_MONTH_PROD_PLAN P ON M.MONTH_PLAN_APS_VERSION = P.MONTH_PLAN_APS_VERSION AND P.EMBRYO_CODE IS NOT NULL AND P.BOM_DATA_VERSION IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO C ON C.EMBRYO_CODE = P.EMBRYO_CODE AND C.EMBRYO_VERSION = P.BOM_DATA_VERSION AND C.Del_Flag = '0' WHERE M.YEAR = #{year} AND M.MONTH = #{month} AND M.IS_FINALIZED = '0' AND M.DEL_FLAG = '0'

SELECT DISTINCT C.ID, C.SAP_CODE, C.EMBRYO_CODE, C.EMBRYO_VERSION, C.SPEC_DESC, C.NOSE_WIDTH, C.FLIP_DISC_DIAMETER, C.TREAD_CODE, C.TREAD_SAP, C.TREAD_VERSION, C.TREAD_RUBBER_CATEGORY, C.TREAD_MOUTH_PLATE, C.TREAD_SHOULDER_LENGTH, C.SIDEWALL_CODE, C.SIDEWALL_SAP, C.SIDEWALL_VERSION, C.SIDEWALL_RUBBER, C.SIDEWALL_MOUTH_PLATE, C.SIDEWALL_LENGTH, C.INSIDE_CODE, C.INSIDE_SAP, C.INSIDE_VERSION, C.INSIDE_RUBBER, C.TIRE_RING_CODE, C.TIRE_RING_SAP, C.TIRE_RING_VERSION, C.APEX_CODE, C.HEXAGON_RUBBER_CODE, C.HEXAGON_MOUTH_PLATE, C.BEAD_CODE, C.BEAD_SAP, C.BEAD_VERSION, C.BEAD_TYPE, C.BEAD_ARRANGE, C.FIT_DRUM_PERIMETER, C.BELT_CUTTING_ANGLE, C.BELT_CODE1, C.BELT_SAP1, C.BELT1_VERSION, C.BELT_CRAFT1, C.BELT_CODE2, C.BELT_SAP2, C.BELT2_VERSION, C.BELT_CRAFT2, C.ARTICLE_CROWN_SPEC, C.ARTICLE_CROWN_SAP, C.ARTICLE_CROWN_VERSION, C.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE1, C.TIRE_FABRIC_SAP1, C.TIRE_FABRIC1_VERSION, C.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT1, C.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE2, C.TIRE_FABRIC_SAP2, C.TIRE_FABRIC2_VERSION, C.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT2, C.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE3, C.TIRE_FABRIC_SAP3, C.TIRE_FABRIC3_VERSION, C.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT3, C.CORD_SPEC, C.CORD_SAP, C.CORD_VERSION, C.ORIGINAL_LINE_CODE, C.DEL_FLAG, C.DIMENSION, C.SECTION_WIDTH, C.HEXAGON_RUBBER_DIMENSION, C.PRODUCTION_STAGE, C.REINFORCE_SEAL_GLUE FROM T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO C WHERE C.EMBRYO_CODE = #{embryoCode} AND C.EMBRYO_VERSION = #{bomVersion} AND C.Del_Flag = '0' ORDER BY C.ID DESC
